decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

The works hereby approved shall only be carried out strictly in accordance with British Standard 3998 [2010] 'Tree Works'.Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved tree[s].

Tree work should not be carried out during periods that are likely to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals.Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of the Wildlife and Countryside Act (1981) and Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2010).

One Quercus robur (10-12cm 'Selected Standard' size) must be planted at the site in the first planting season [November to March] or part thereof following the commencement of works on site. The Local Planning Authority must be informed in writing once the replacement tree has been planted. The location of the new tree must be as close as possible to the old.Reason: In the interests of visual amenity and in order to maintain tree population at this site after the removal of the preserved trees and in accordance with the requirements of Section 206 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
